ढ: ढ The aspirate of the preceding letter corresponding to Ḍh: the use of this as an initial letter is very limited, and several of the words in which it occurs can scarely be regarded as pure Sanscrit.
ढ m. (ढः) 1 A large drum. 2 A dog. 3 A dog's tail. 4 Sound. 5 A serpent.
ढक्क: ढक्क m. (-क्कः) 1 A city or district, Dhacca or Dacca. 2 Coveting, disappearance. f. (-क्का) A large or double drum, a Ḍhāk. E. ढक् imitative sound, and क what utters.
ढक्कारी: ढक्कारी f. (-री) The goddess TĀRIṆĪ, a Tāntrika form of DURGĀ.
ढालिन्: ढालिन् m. (-ली) A warrior armed with a shield, a shield-bearer.
ढुढ: ढुढ (इ) ढढि Sautra root, (ढुण्ढति) To search, to seek.
ढुण्ढन: ढुण्ढन n. (-नं) Seeking, investigating. E. ढुढि to search, ल्युट् aff.
ढुण्ढि: ढुण्ढि m. (-ण्ढिः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. ढुढि to seek, कि aff.
ढुण्ढित: ढुण्ढित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired. E. ढुढि to seek, क्त aff.
ढोल: ढोल m. (-लः) A Dhol or large drum.
ढौक: ढौक (ऋ) ढौकृ r. 1st cl. (ढौकते) To go or move.
ढौकन: ढौकन m. (-नः) A bribe. E. ढौक to go, ल्यु aff. ण
